[color=#93c47d][size=4]Mod Description
[/size][/color]I wasn't satisfied with the looks of the family so I decided to mod them for my own use. 
Sebastian takes after his mother while Maru looks a lot more like Demetrius. I was quite happy with the way it turned out so I decided to share with you guys ! It's my first mod and it's far from being perfect so feel free to give me constructive criticism !


[img]http://i68.tinypic.com/iei2p3.png[/img]
